name: Hell's Gate
source:
Long ago there were angels and demons in this world. However, a conflict over a trivial matter divided the world into Heaven and Hell.
At the border only gatekeeper Elle protects the shaky peace. One day angel Yuu shows up before her. Elle tries to catch Yuu, but...
